messages:
Jordan Lee: Follow-up on iterator/resume conversation. We need to decide on three things: token polymorphism (single token for pages+streams), who owns retry logic (SDK vs server), and how to document unsafe resumes.

Mira Patel: My take: one opaque token shape for everything is fine, but include a type prefix so server can encode semantics (e.g. `PAG:` vs `STR:`). SDKs treat token as opaque but surface a small enum `resume_kind` on page objects.

Samir Rao: I'm worried about coupling: if token semantics change we might falsely advertise resume support. We should pair the token with a transport-level capability flag `resume_guarantee: "best-effort" | "exactly-once" | "none"`. SDK behavior differs by that flag.

Priya Desai: Concrete UX: page object fields: `items`, `resume_token` (optional), `resume_kind` (one of `cursor|stream|checkpoint`), and `resumable` boolean. Example: `if page.resumable: client.resume(page.resume_token)`

Jordan Lee: Ok, but we must minimize surface area per language. For TS: async iterator + helper `client.resumeList(token)`. For Python/Go: sync iterator + `client.resume_list(token)`. Keep names aligned but idiomatic casing.

Mira Patel: Retry responsibility: SDK retries network / transient transport errors automatically. For server errors that might have side effects, SDK should NOT retry unless an `idempotency_key` was provided by the user (or `idempotency=true` flag). Default: no server-side retry.

Samir Rao: Agree. Also add a call-level flag `allow_resume_on_failure` (false by default). If true, SDK will attempt to resume using token where server supports resume semantics. This must be opt-in.

Priya Desai: Docs + errors: define `ResumeUnsupportedError`, `ResumeAmbiguousError` (server says resume possible but state diverged), and `IdempotencyRequiredError`. Include code snippet: 

```
# Python
for page in client.list_embeddings(prompt, allow_resume_on_failure=True):
    process(page.items)
# if it raises ResumeAmbiguousError -> client should not auto-retry
```

Jordan Lee: Telemetry: emit `resume_attempt`, `resume_result` (`ok|ambiguous|unsupported`), `idempotency_provided`. This will help us find common failure modes.

Mira Patel: Backoff defaults we discussed before still stand: exponential + jitter. Add special-case for resume attempts: shorter backoff (two tries) because resume is quick handshake.

Samir Rao: Implementation note: make resume token max size limit (e.g. 8kb) and reject larger tokens early in SDK to prevent bad actors. Server should also cap.

Priya Desai: Edge case: paginated lists that reference live mutable resources (e.g., search results). Resume might yield different items — document eventual consistency expectations.

Jordan Lee: Action items: Mira will prototype transport capability frame, Samir will add SDK flag `allow_resume_on_failure` + telemetry, Priya will draft docs and error taxonomy. Target: demo in next eng-platform sync.

eng-bot: Created task checklists: [ ] transport-capability-proto, [ ] sdk-resume-flag, [ ] docs-resume-errors.
